purpose: Six coherent consolidated visual proposals; not application screenshots

initial.title: Overview
initial.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. High fidelity final consolidated UI proposal for AdaptOps, one desktop SaaS application page per image. Reference images are STYLE AND SHELL REFERENCES, not source facts. Maintain exact same navigation, typography, header, colors and proportions across the entire six-page set. Canvas 1600 by 1000, approximately 16:10, full flat front-on product screenshot, crisp and legible. Do not create a marketing slide, collage, device frame, browser chrome or concept-art presentation.
Design: refined calm professional operational software. Inter font; deep ink #142036, white surfaces, cool near-white #f4f7f9, deep teal #145c68 buttons; thin #e2e9ee borders; restrained amber/red attention, muted green opportunity. Precise alignment, flat surfaces, generous but purposeful whitespace, compact readable tables, small outline icons. Strong typography hierarchy. No gradients, glow, glass, sparkles, stars, robot avatars, decorative charts, invented performance metrics, giant empty cards, endless pill badges, skeleton text or lorem ipsum. No em dash characters.
Shared chrome: fixed 200px pale sidebar; top header 64px. Wordmark "AdaptOps" at top-left, workspace "Demo Materials", top-right "22 Oct 2026" and Paul avatar. Sidebar items exactly "Overview", "Watchtower", "Actions", "Company", "Data & Connections". Selected item gets pale teal tint and teal icon/text. Bottom-left "Demo workspace". Top-right small tag "Design proposal". Very small footer "Synthetic company data · Controlled demo event". English UI.
Shared company/scenario, keep identical facts across pages: French multi-site materials distributor. Sites "Lille", "Central", "South". Product ISO100, ISO120 is not an authorised substitute. Site A needs 8 ISO100 pallets by 23 Oct. Site B's 8 ISO100 pallets remain reserved for 5 Nov. A controlled ERP event at 10:32 reschedules an inbound delivery beyond Site A's need date. This is a synthetic internal fact, NOT proven by public news. Emergency purchase option costs €1,420 in total; this is proposed cost, not savings. Transfer remains conditional on replenishment; never portray it as safely available. A separate synthetic CRM event at 10:28 is additional demand "To qualify". A public source collected 10:14 is "ROCKWOOL capacity announcement", labelled "Historical context"; future capacity announcement, no confirmed link to the delay. No invented factory fire or supplier attribution.
Where an assistant appears, title exactly "Ask AdaptOps", simple speech-bubble icon and plain circular A monogram, no AI sparkles. Answers reference the displayed dossier and sources. One main action per surface. Business meaning comes before technical provenance, which stays accessible. Image must be a beautiful realistic usable SaaS UI with accurate short English text. Preserve legibility rather than adding extra content.

PAGE 01 OVERVIEW. Sidebar Overview selected. Base layout on the overview-with-activity-rail reference: broad main work area and narrower Watchtower rail on right, all aligned.
Main page headline "Your operations, in focus." Subtitle "Your briefing is ready. Here is what needs a decision." Compact company context "Materials distribution · Lille / Central / South".
One quiet summary strip: "1 Needs attention" / "1 Opportunity to qualify" / "1 Awaiting review".
Main dominant briefing dossier: small amber "Needs attention"; headline "Protect Site A without disrupting Site B". Three concise horizontal steps "What changed" / "Business impact" / "Recommended response". Their content: "Inbound delivery rescheduled"; "8 ISO100 pallets needed by 23 Oct"; "Review the €1,420 purchase option". Below a compact two-row commitments table with Site A "At risk" and Site B "Reservation protected". Main CTA "Review dossier". Secondary link "Sources & calculations".
Below, one smaller opportunity row "Additional demand to qualify" with "Check product, quantity and delivery window before making an offer." Link "Open opportunity".
Right rail "Watchtower", source freshness "Last collection 10:32"; exactly three recent events with times and small source/status: 10:32 "Inbound delivery rescheduled", "ERP simulation", "Needs attention"; 10:28 "Additional demand received", "CRM simulation", "To qualify"; 10:14 "ROCKWOOL capacity announcement", "Public source", "Historical context". Link "Open Watchtower".
At bottom of main column a compact contextual Ask AdaptOps bar with placeholder "What would you like to understand about your business?" Assistant collapsed. Do not fill page with a chat. Professional clear dashboard.
